review.tagline: Browser front-end for Hermes Agent with sessions, workspace files and profiles
review.summary: Hermes WebUI is a three-panel web interface for Nous Research's Hermes Agent, written in Python with vanilla JS and no build step. It runs the agent in-process using your existing Hermes config, and adds streaming chat, tool call cards, session projects and tags, a workspace file browser and profile switching. Optional password, passkey and OIDC login are available; native Windows is not supported by the bootstrap.
review.audience: Hermes Agent users who want a browser UI reachable over SSH tunnel or Tailscale
strengths: No build step or bundler: Python backend with vanilla JS frontend
Reuses existing Hermes Agent config, models and memory without extra setup
Optional password, passkey/WebAuthn and OIDC auth; off by default for localhost
Includes ctl.sh daemon control, Docker, compose and a Nix flake/module
weaknesses: Requires Hermes Agent; bootstrap installs it via a curl-piped script if missing
Native Windows not supported by bootstrap; community guide only
OIDC state is in process memory, so multi-instance needs sticky sessions
Full agent-loop delegation to an external gateway is not yet shipped
needs: Models: OpenAI, Anthropic, Google, DeepSeek, OpenRouter
